description: Source code for Git's credential cache command implementation, handling socket communication with a credential daemon, including starting, requesting, and managing credentials via UNIX sockets.

methods.name: connection_closed
methods.description: Checks if the connection was closed based on error code, varies for Windows and Unix.

methods.name: connection_fatally_broken
methods.description: Determines if the connection is considered fatally broken based on error code, varies for Windows and Unix.

methods.name: send_request
methods.description: Sends a request over a UNIX socket and reads the response.

methods.name: spawn_daemon
methods.description: Starts the credential cache daemon process.

methods.name: do_cache
methods.description: Performs cache actions like get, store, erase, or exit by communicating with the daemon.

methods.name: get_socket_path
methods.description: Determines the socket path for credential cache communication.

methods.name: cmd_credential_cache
methods.description: Main command handler for credential cache operations, parsing options and executing actions.
